King Charles to host AI leaders for global good discussion

King Charles will host leaders from major artificial intelligence companies to discuss the technology's use for the global good. The meeting aims to explore whether a shared set of principles is needed for AI development. Concerns about the potential threats posed by AI are also a backdrop to the discussions.
